# Wireframes of the writers' pages

The wireframes of the pages this layer's writers draw for other layers' visualisers, under `wireframes/`: an `index.json`, and one directory per wireframe holding `intent.md`, an as-is candidate `.html`, and `checks/report.json` with its screenshots from `bun run cat wireframe:check`. A wireframe here covers a writer by `renderedBy:<tool>`, so every declared visualiser that Tool draws inherits it (`check:wireframes`; owner, 2026-11-17, option b: one shared ArchiMate wireframe). It is this layer's site directory, and declaring it is what makes a mount of this layer bring it, so `check:wireframes` reads it wherever this layer is mounted.

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-docs`, holding `docs`.
